name: 滿版影片＋左下大標題
desc: 背景為滿版影片，左下角放靠左對齊的大標題，上方可放一段較小的副標；其餘畫面只留背景。
prompt: 背景為滿版影片。主視覺左下角放大標題（可多行），靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，約佔畫面寬的六成；畫面上方與右側只留背景，不放其他元素。大標題上方可放一段明顯較小的副標，沒有內容時省略，大標題位置不變。
mobile: 仍撐滿一個畫面，高度要避免網址列伸縮造成跳動；背景影片改為直式裁切。大標題仍在左下角、靠左對齊，寬度改為接近整個畫面寬，完整落在頁面內容寬度內，不超出畫面邊緣；副標改放到大標題下方。沒有捲動效果，結構其餘不變。

en.name: Full-bleed video with bottom-left headline
en.desc: A full-bleed background video with a left-aligned headline in the bottom-left corner and an optional smaller subheading above it; the rest of the screen shows only the background.
en.prompt: The background is a full-bleed video. Place a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) in the bottom-left corner of the hero, left-aligned to the page content width, taking about sixty percent of the viewport width; the top and right of the hero show only the background, with no other elements. Optionally place a noticeably smaller subheading above the headline; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline.
en.mobile: Still fills one viewport, and the height should avoid jumping when the mobile address bar expands or collapses; the background video is cropped to portrait. The headline stays in the bottom-left corner, left-aligned, and widens to nearly the full viewport width, staying fully within the page content width without overflowing the viewport edge; the subheading moves below the headline. There is no scroll effect; the rest of the structure is unchanged.
